shots.visual: Close-up of a warlord's face, flames reflecting in his eyes, blood leaking from mouth under intense red fire light.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這一次，朕要讓這天下易主！

shots.visual: Medium shot of a warrior collapsing into a sea of raging flames on a dark night battlefield.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 夷陵烈火，吞噬大蜀氣數。

shots.visual: Close-up zoom into a sleeping warlord suddenly opening his eyes in shock inside a candlelit tent.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 朕……竟然重生了？

shots.visual: Medium pan shot revealing intact war maps, armor, and weapons laid out on a wooden table inside tent.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這是火起前的夷陵主帳！

shots.visual: Medium shot with a smart adviser on left holding feather fan, bowing to the commander sitting on right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，全軍已準備追擊吳軍！

shots.visual: Close-up of commander's eyes turning cold and dangerous as he clenches his fist on the desk.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳朕軍令，全軍停止追擊！

shots.visual: Close-up zoom on the adviser's stunned face, his feather fan halting abruptly in mid-air.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公！東吳已破，為何停手？

shots.visual: Medium shot of commander standing up abruptly, sweeping his cape with dominant authority.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 陸遜聯營四十里，正等我們入坑！

shots.visual: Close-up of adviser staring wide-eyed, shocked by such precise foresighted knowledge.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公如何得知陸遜的伏計？

shots.visual: Close-up zoom of commander pointing sternly at the northern border on the map.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳令！轉向北方，防備曹魏！

shots.visual: Medium shot of an ambitious emperor on throne sipping wine with a cruel smile in a grand palace hall.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 劉備必敗於夷陵，天下是朕的！

shots.visual: Medium shot of a sinister lord standing on a warship deck, looking over the foggy river with arrogance.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 大火一響，蜀軍將灰飛煙滅！

shots.visual: Wide shot in tent with adviser pleading on the left and commander standing rigidly on the right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公！全軍皆欲為二位將軍報仇！

shots.visual: Close-up of commander's face, cold and ruthless while concealing deep sorrow within his eyes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 兄弟私仇，怎敵大蜀社稷！

shots.visual: Medium zoom shot of adviser stepping forward urgently, expressing deep anxiety.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 此時撤退，軍心必定動搖！

shots.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot as commander walks past adviser on right without looking back.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 動搖者，以軍法處置！

shots.visual: Close-up zoom of adviser sweating, completely stunned by his lord's terrifying personality change.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，今日為何如此冷酷？

shots.visual: Medium shot of commander turning back sharply, his hand resting tightly on sword hilt.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 朕死過一次，自然清醒了！

shots.visual: Medium shot with adviser on left raising hands in emotional argument against ruler on right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 若不報仇，何以面對天下人！

shots.visual: Close-up zoom of commander unsheathing sharp steel sword half out with metallic ring.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 從今往後，朕說了算！

shots.visual: Medium freeze frame: ruler on left drawing sword completely and pointing blade straight at adviser on right.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 誰敢再提攻吳，斬！
